note: compare steered_alpha=X against a CONTROL arm, not against unsteered generation; all arms carry identical SAE reconstruction error and share a sampling seed. Two controls are reported per strength: 'alpha=X' pairs against a uniformly drawn feature set matched on count and magnitude, 'alpha=X_rate_matched' against one additionally matched on firing rate. The rate-matched arm is the stronger control and is what the paper quotes. Read 'paired', not 'aggregate': the marginal means are taken over different target sets per arm.
